products.title: DSPIAE SS-S02 Fine Sanding Sponge Set #1000 - #2500 (30pcs)

description.plain:
DSPIAE SS-S02 Fine Sanding Sponge Set #1000 - #2500 (30pcs)

Includes a total of 30 pieces of sanding sponges in various thickness and grits. 

Comes with a 5 compartment storage box.

Size: 72 x 20mm

Thickness: 2mm/3mm/5mm (2 of each for each grit)

S02 Set Includes: #1000, #1200, #1500, #2000, and #2500 grit sanding sponges

The user can use coarse grits on pieces that require less precision in the sanding. The sanding block is made from EVA material that is soft and flexible, perfect for sanding curved edges. The grits are color coded, making it easy to distinguish. Grits are labeled clearly at the back, allowing users to choose their tools without hassle. With three thickness to choose from, it is versatile for any situation. Every set comes with 2 of each thickness for each grit. The user is able to cut the sponge into their desired size or use the product immediately. Freely customize to your desired size. Use your first and middle finger to hold the sponge. Apply force with your index finger for maximum effect. Made from memory foam, the sponge always goes back to its original shape.

description.plain:
Sanding Sponges

These Flexible Sanding Sponges are designed for more abrasive sanding tasks, offering a thicker, firmer grip that allows for better control and pressure.

These sponges are ideal for removing old finishes, smoothing rough surfaces, and creating a distressed look. Compared to sanding pads, they are more aggressive and will feel scratchier and less smooth, making them better suited for heavier prep work.

Available in both square and angled shapes, these sponges are versatile for all areas of your project. The angled option is especially helpful for getting into grooves, corners, and detailed furniture profiles, while the rectangular shape works well on flat surfaces.

For lighter prep or a simple scuff sand before painting, sanding pads are recommended. These sponges are best when you need more bite and faster material removal.

Grit Guide

Fine  (Square & Angled)
Perfect for lighter sanding, refining surfaces, and preparing for paint.

Medium/Fine ( Square & Angled)
Ideal for general sanding and smoothing surfaces after heavier prep.

Medium Coarse (Square)
Best for heavy-duty sanding, removing old finishes, and tackling rough or uneven surfaces.

Angled Sponges
Designed to reach into grooves, edges, and detailed areas where flat sanding tools can’t easily reach.
